name: astryx
description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
one_liner: A free, ready-made set of 150+ website building blocks (buttons, forms, menus) from Meta that both human developers and AI coding assistants can use to build consistent-looking apps fast.
buyer: No direct buyer for the library itself — it's free dev infrastructure; the opportunity is in building on top of it for paying clients.
business_use_cases: A web dev agency standardizes on it to build client sites and dashboards faster using pre-built, accessible components.
A startup uses one of its ready-made themes to ship a polished-looking MVP without hiring a designer.
A UI consultant builds and sells custom Astryx themes to companies wanting a unique look without starting from scratch.

money_ideas.idea: Design and sell custom branded themes for Astryx to companies who want a distinctive look fast

steal_this: Build a few polished custom Astryx themes this weekend and sell them to startups as instant, professional UI kits.
